topography.project_purpose: Dexs. Structurally: 34 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 7 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs, 1 Chainlink feed; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, lbhooksbasesimplerewarder, lbhooksbaserewarder). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
